item.title: Microsoft blocks trick to unlock native NVMe driver, but workarounds still exist
item.description:
📝 The native NVMe driver (nvmedisk. The registry trick came with caveats, though. While the registry method is dead, users can still enable native NVMe through ViVeTool, according to Deskmodder, a third-party utility that toggles hidden Windows features.
🔗 Read more: https://www.tomshardware.com/software/windows/microsoft-blocks-the-registry-hack-trick-that-unlocked-native-nvme-performance-on-windows-11
